name: Capture weighted native source organs and weave proposals
description: Verifies the primary Signal Machine workflow exposes native organs, freezes a weighted capture, and renders visual proposals.
steps: Keep Browser Local and Source Material enabled
Inspect the Influence receipt and proposal grid
expected: A frozen session is visible with Browser Local and Source Material influence percentages, and twelve visual proposal cards are rendered.

name: Add a working-chat organ with provenance
description: Verifies a working chat can become one weighted source organ instead of replacing the machine.
steps: Enter {"themes":["glass forest","repair"],"energy":0.8} in its JSON input and "working-chat QA" in its provenance input
Set Working Chat influence weight above zero and press "Capture + weave"
expected: Working Chat appears in the frozen Influence receipt with a visible normalized percentage and packet fingerprint.

name: Internet Eye reduces observations before exposure
description: Verifies raw Shodan-compatible observations are reduced before the frozen session is exposed.
steps: Enter {"matches":[{"ip_str":"203.0.113.55","hostnames":["hidden.invalid"],"port":443,"transport":"tcp","location":{"country_code":"NL"},"product":"nginx","org":"Example Org","data":"private banner","ssl":{"enabled":true}}]} in its JSON input
Enter "QA indexed fixture" as provenance and press "Capture + weave", then open "Inspect frozen source packets"
expected: Internet Eye is present as target-blind aggregate influence, while the raw IP, hostname, organization name, and banner text are not visible in the frozen session JSON.

name: Reject missing provenance without replacing the prior session
description: Verifies a provenance-required source cannot silently enter a capture.
steps: Enter {"signal":0.5} in its JSON input but leave provenance empty
expected: A visible error says Connector Packet requires provenance and no new session receipt replaces the prior frozen session.

name: Explicitly save and reload a frozen session on mobile
description: Verifies persistence occurs only after the user explicitly requests it.
expected: The frozen session remains visible with the same session fingerprint and influence receipt after explicit reload.
